newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane mixed in uptick of Midwest demand.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane mixed in uptick of Midwest demand.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were mixed in late trade on Tuesday with prices edging up in the Midwest due to an uptick in demand, players said.
"Guys who need barrels are buying them now. They are picking them up hand to mouth," said one Conway trader, noting the cold weather has been the main support to propane prices.
In the Midwest, Conway, Kansas, hub spot propane edged up a half cent to between 79.50 cents and 80.00 cents a barrel.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot material remained steady at 64.75/65.25 cents, players said.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
